name: @pipeworx/mcp-superhero

tools.name: list_all
tools.description: List all superheroes in the database with their IDs, names, and slugs.

tools.name: get_hero
tools.description: Get full data for a superhero by their numeric ID, including powerstats, biography, appearance, and images.

tools.name: get_powerstats
tools.description: Get power statistics (intelligence, strength, speed, durability, power, combat) for a superhero by ID.

tools.name: get_biography
tools.description: Get biography details (full name, aliases, publisher, first appearance, alignment) for a superhero by ID.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-superhero forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the superhero pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
